kicker: For the one you're carrying to Jesus
truth: Some people can't get to Jesus on their own. That's what you're for.
prayer: Lord, there's someone I've been carrying in prayer so long I'm tired. Don't let me stop before the roof breaks open. Let my faith move for the one who's out of strength to believe right now. In Jesus' name, amen.
save: Save this for the friend you're carrying
